'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Jake Nelson LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' MN States Lightside
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
